properties.name: Stream channel debris flow
properties.description: A forested stream scoured to bare rock and gravel for about 900 m, from the top of the survey down across the road at the S-bend and on to the south-west edge.

properties.name: Head slide
properties.description: Open-slope slide on the east side of the stream head; its debris ran west into the scoured channel.

properties.name: Bank slide
properties.description: Small slide off the east bank of the channel, above the road.

properties.name: Hairpin slides
properties.description: A cluster of slope failures on and below the road where it winds down in hairpins: debris lay across the road and ran down the slope below it - the road blockage reported between Launglon and Pa Nyit.

properties.name: East channel
properties.description: A gully scoured down the slope east of the main stream.

properties.name: North-east channel
properties.description: A wide scoured channel at the north-east edge of the survey; it continues beyond the flight.

properties.name: Slides above the S-bend
properties.description: Two small slides on the slope just above the road where it crosses the stream.
